capability.name: Function Abuse Risk Governance
capability.controlObjective: Risk appetite and tolerance for abuse of legitimate functions are defined at board level, with ownership, change authority, and escalation paths established.

controls.name: Risk appetite statement for function abuse
controls.description: Board-approved statement defining acceptable residual risk from misuse of legitimate system functions (e.g., bulk export, admin overrides).

controls.name: Risk tolerance thresholds for function abuse
controls.description: Quantified boundaries: max acceptable number of unmonitored privileged functions, max time-to-detect for anomalous function usage, max acceptable coverage gaps.

controls.name: Define system ownership for all critical assets

workforce.name: Board / Risk Committee
workforce.description: Approves risk appetite for function abuse; reviews annually or after material incidents.

workforce.name: CRO / CISO
workforce.description: Translates appetite into measurable tolerance thresholds; reports tolerance breaches to Board.

workforce.name: CIO
workforce.description: Ensures function inventories and change authorities align with stated risk tolerance.

governance.name: Annual risk appetite review for function abuse
governance.description: Board-level review of appetite statement, informed by incident trends and business changes.

governance.name: Tolerance breach escalation procedure
governance.description: Automatic escalation to CRO/CISO when tolerance thresholds are exceeded; Board notification within 48h for material breaches.

capability.name: Function Surface Mapping
capability.controlObjective: All exposed functions, administrative interfaces, and configurable features are inventoried with their intended scope and trust level.

controls.name: Map administrative interfaces and exposed APIs
Red team exercises targeting function abuse scenarios
controls.description: Adversary simulation exercises that test the full attack chain: can an attacker discover, reach, and misuse legitimate functions (bulk export, admin overrides, API abuse) to achieve objectives?

workforce.name: Red Team Operators
workforce.description: Plan and execute adversary simulation exercises across the function abuse attack surface; produce findings mapped to TLCTC cluster #1.

controls.name: Disable unnecessary features and default accounts

controls.name: Monitor bulk operations and off-hours admin actions

capability.name: Function Abuse Containment
capability.controlObjective: When function misuse is confirmed, affected features can be isolated and abuse pathways blocked within defined SLAs.

controls.name: Automated session termination on abuse detection

capability.name: Function Abuse Recovery
capability.controlObjective: After a function-abuse incident, hardened baselines are restored and controls are strengthened to prevent recurrence.

governance.name: Lessons learned process for function abuse
